title: First exterior sheaf is the original sheaf
statement: For every scheme X and sheaf of modules M on X, the sheafified sectionwise exterior power exteriorSheaf M 1 [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] is isomorphic to M.

proof.text: On each open use exteriorPower.oneEquiv. Naturality follows on singleton wedges from PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower_map_ιMulti. Sheafify the presheaf isomorphism and compose with the invertible counit at M. This is the official exteriorPower implementation of the sectionwise exterior sheaf [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power].
